main_measure.name: mean excess next-day return over bet bars (vs coin's mean daily return)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 100 cases; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 100 cases

supporting_check.name: top fifth by forecast minus other four fifths, mean excess return (Welch t > 0)

decided_by: The mean excess next-day return is above 0 with t >= 2, but the supporting check (top fifth vs other four fifths, Welch t > 0) fails.
reading: Situation taken as the raw surge-times-low-close product being above 0 on a long (positive) forecast bar; cases are long bets (forecast rise >= 2 points from its lowest level since the last bet, from 0 after flat) with a next-day return inside the window; the top fifth is the floor(n/5) cases with the largest forecast (stable sort), the rest are the other four fifths.
